BIS payloads carry no historical availability stamps and the repo holds no per-event announcement records. HISTORICAL_MARKET_AVAILABILITY = UNPROVEN. V3R replaces this with per-event evidenced announcement timestamps or the conservative LATER bound (AVAILABILITY_UNEVIDENCED).

section7_announcement_ledger_coverage_pl.window_rationale: macro fetch starts _START_PERIOD=2019-01-01 (macro_fetch.py, frozen); scored fold boundaries 2020-03-01 / 2022-05-01 / 2024-07-01 / 2026-09-02T23:59:59Z (scored_runner.py, frozen). The scored books therefore read decisions over the frozen vintages' full span 2019-01-01..2026-09-01; the ledger covers every change event with effective date in that span.

event_counts_measured_from_frozen_vintag.method: distinct policy_rate value changes in data_raw/forex_free_v3_macro/<area>.json (the exact frozen byte-pinned inputs the scored run read; file hashes in w3_freeze.json data_freeze.macro_vintages.file_sha256)

section7_announcement_ledger_coverage_pl.baseline_rationale: the level in force at window start was itself set by a pre-window change event (e.g. US 2018-12-20 effective); one BASELINE_LEVEL row per area evidences that establishing announcement so every readable rate in the scored window traces to an evidenced timestamp

section7_announcement_ledger_coverage_pl.unevidenced_rule: events without an official-source evidenced announcement stamp are recorded AVAILABILITY_UNEVIDENCED and take the LATER of (end of effective day, first BIS publication stamp) - never the earlier
